title: Crüger to Müller, 12/22 April 1634
author: Peter Crüger
source: Peter Crüger's letter to Philipp Müller written at Danzig on 12/22 April 1634, asking what has become of the papers of Kepler and Bartsch and of Tycho Brahe's observations. The original is in the Bibliothèque de l'Observatoire, Paris (B, 1, 9; 89, 9. Z. 46). Printed in extracts in *Nova Kepleriana* 4, ed. Walther von Dyck and Max Caspar, Abhandlungen der Bayerischen Akademie der Wissenschaften, Math.-naturw. Abteilung 31, no. 1 (Munich, 1927), 111.
transcribed_from: the page images of the 1927 printing.
summary: Crüger asks where the papers of Kepler and Bartsch and Tycho's observations now are, and wishes they were somewhere safe from the wars.
